reason: J.B. Hunt sells North American surface freight services (intermodal, dedicated trucking, brokerage, final-mile) to retail, consumer and manufacturing shippers. Pangaea sells global ocean dry bulk shipping and port logistics to commodity producers and traders. Both are asset-based freight carriers, but the mode, the cargo and the buyers are different.
